search_text: published ZDI-21-339 ZDI-CAN-12361 (Pwn2Own) Synology DiskStation Manager StartEngCommPipeServer HandleSendMsg Out-Of-Bounds Read Information Disclosure Vulnerability 2021-03-22 CVE-2021-27647 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2021-27647 4.3 AV:A/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:N ['Synology'] ['DiskStation Manager'] This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of Synology DS418play. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the processing of the HandleSendMsg parameter sent to StartEngCommPipeServer. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in a read past the end of an allocated structure.
